name: CRUNCHES WITH LEGS RAISED
introduce: Lie on your back with your legs straight up towards the ceiling and your hands behind your ears. \n\nLift your shoulders up off the floor, then slowly go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please don’t move your legs when lifting your shoulders.
Please pause for a second when lifting your shoulders up.
Exhale when raising your shoulders, and inhale when lowering them.
This exercise strengthens your rectus abdominis.
